name: Felsőzsolca (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of three stripes, green, yellow and green, charged near the top of the yellow with the town arms of Felsőzsolca: a green shield with a white chevron and a ploughshare, with a grey eagle crest.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
